title: Prioritisation: why ABC beats everything else

lines.say: Prioritisation. Why A, B, C beats everything else.
Two patients need you at the same time. Who do you see first? It's not a judgement call.
Airway comes first, then breathing, then circulation. And on the exam, A, B, C beats Maslow whenever both apply.
Next, unstable beats stable. A sudden change in someone's condition outranks a result that's abnormal, but steady.
And actual problems usually come before potential ones. The exception? A potential airway problem. That always comes first.
In Australia, emergency departments triage on the Australasian Triage Scale, from category one to five.
